neighbours.label: A run of official proper names strung together in formal writing (a person's title plus their organisation, a venue plus its city, a citation's publisher and place, two named brands joined by '&'), lighting up on a name or on the linking word inside the run (of, at, &, a comma). Quiet: the same kinds of sentence with everyday common nouns in place of the names, and lone casual mentions of a single name.
neighbours.short: runs of official names (title+org, venue+city, citations)
